chunks.sanskrit: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam evam eva śivabhāsas taṃ numo bhaktiśālinam
chunks.l1:
## s01-v01 (1)
not / of-one-meditating / not / of-one-chanting / may-there-be / of-whom / without-preceding-rule / thus / indeed / Śiva-light / him / we-bow / bhakti-possessing // UtSst_1.1
chunks.l2: Of one who neither meditates nor chants, manifestation may come without any preparatory rule. Just so — O light of Śiva — we bow to him who possesses devotion.
chunks.l3:
He neither sits in thought nor tells a bead — yet may it dawn for him, with no rule first.
Just so, just so — O Śiva's light — we bow to him who loves.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v01 — argument map

*na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam.* No meditation, no japa, no preparation — and yet the manifestation occurs. The stotra opens by denying method as precondition, not as practice.

chunks.sanskrit: ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san lokayātrārajorāgāt palitair iva dhūsaraḥ
chunks.l1:
## s01-v02 (2)
self / my / of-Your-devotion-nectar / by-drinking / young / though / being / of-world-journey / by-dust / of-passion / with-grey-hairs / as-if / dimmed // UtSst_1.2
chunks.l2: My self stays young, drinking the nectar of Your devotion — though greyed as if with the dust of worldly journeying and its passions.
chunks.l3:
My self stays young, drinking Your love's nectar —
greyed as if with road-dust, dust that is passion.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v02 — argument map

*ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san.* The self stays young drinking devotion-nectar while the body greys with world-dust. Youth = the self's nature; age = the journey's dust. (Lakshmanjoo: internally young.)

### Open
- v.2 *palitair iva dhūsaraḥ* — age vs weariness of travel; simile scope uncertain.

chunks.sanskrit: labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām saṃcāro lokamārge 'pi syāt tayaiva vijṛmbhayā
chunks.l1:
## s01-v03 (3)
of-those-who-have-gained / that / wealth / of-bhakti-possessors / in-Your-city / of-dwellers / movement / in-world-path / even / may-it-be / by-that-very / expansion // UtSst_1.3
chunks.l2: For those who have gained that wealth — the possessors of devotion dwelling in Your city — even movement along worldly paths happens by that very expansion.
chunks.l3:
For those who've won that wealth — lovers homed in Your city —
may even their world-road walking be that same unfolding.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v03 — argument map

*labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām.* For wealth-holders dwelling in Your city, even worldly movement happens by that same expansion. The world is not abandoned; it is moved in differently.

chunks.sanskrit: sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetram mantraḥ kvaiṣām na siddhyati
chunks.l1:
## s01-v04 (4)
directly / consisting-of-You / O-Lord / in-all / within-the-world / what / not / of-bhakti-possessors / field / mantra / of-whom / not / succeeds // UtSst_1.4
chunks.l2: Lord — where the whole world within worlds directly consists of You, what is not the devotee's field, and whose mantra does not succeed?
chunks.l3:
Lord — where world within world stands bare-faced You,
what is not the lover's ground? where does his prayer fail?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v04 — argument map

*sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare.* Where all the world is directly You, what is not the devotee's field, what mantra fails? Omnipresence converts the whole world into ritual ground.

chunks.sanskrit: jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ advitīyā api sadā tvaddvitīyā api prabho
chunks.l1:
## s01-v05 (5)
victorious / of-bhakti-nectar-rasa / with-the-best-wine / intoxicated / non-dual / though / always / Your / second / though / O-Lord // UtSst_1.5
chunks.l2: Victory to those intoxicated with the finest wine of devotion's nectar-essence! Though non-dual, they are ever Your second, O Lord.
chunks.l3:
They win — the drunk, high on love's nectar-wine!
Second to none, yet never without You beside them, Lord.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v05 — argument map

*jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ.* Victory to the intoxicated — drunk on the best wine, devotion-nectar. Intoxication is praise, not blame: it names excess of love.

chunks.sanskrit: anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te tādṛśa eva ye sāndrabhaktyānandarasāplutāḥ
chunks.l1:
## s01-v06 (6)
of-endless-bliss / of-the-ocean / of-You / O-Lord / truth / know / they / such / indeed / those-who / in-dense / bhakti-bliss-nectar / drenched // UtSst_1.6
chunks.l2: Lord of the ocean of endless bliss — only they know Your truth who are densely drenched in blissful devotion's nectar.
chunks.l3:
Lord of the endless-bliss sea — Your truth is known by just such ones:
the flooded, thick-drenched in love's bliss-nectar.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v06 — argument map

*anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te.* Only the densely drenched know the ocean. Knowledge here is immersion-depth, not information. (Restricts 1.4: all is field, but only the drowned know.)

chunks.sanskrit: tvam evātmeśa sarvasya sarvaś cātmani rāgavān iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s01-v07 (7)
You / indeed / O-Lord-of-self / of-all / all / and / in-self / attached / thus / as-self-established / Your-devotion / knowing / may-he-conquer / man // UtSst_1.7
chunks.l2: You alone, Lord of the self, are the nature of all, and all loves dwelling in the self. Knowing Your devotion as self-established, may a person conquer.
chunks.l3:
You alone, self's Lord, are all men's nature, and all men love within the self — so this love stands on its own ground.
Who knows it, knowing by drowning — let him conquer.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v07 — argument map

*tvam evātmeśa sarvasya... iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ.* THE CENTER. All desire the self; You alone are everyone's conscious self; hence devotion to You is self-established — and one who knows it **by immersion's means** (*samāveśayuktyā*, Kṣemarāja) conquers, i.e., lives supreme. The liṅ (*jayet*) is injunctive (Kṣemarāja: *niyoge liṅ*). Argument: since the object is the self, love of it needs no external ground.

chunks.sanskrit: nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ vedyavedakasaṃkṣobhe 'py asi bhaktaiḥ sudarśanaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s01-v08 (8)
O-Lord / of-the-knowable / on-destruction / by-whom / not / seen / alone / standing / of-knower-and-knowable / in-agitation / even / you-are / by-devotees / easily-seen // UtSst_1.8
chunks.l2: Lord — when the knowable is destroyed, by whom are You not seen, standing alone? Even amid the agitation of knower and knowable, You are easily seen by devotees.
chunks.l3:
Lord — the known destroyed, who would not see You standing all alone?
Even in the known-knower churn, lovers find You easy.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v08 — argument map

*nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ.* When the knowable is destroyed, who does not see You standing alone? Negation as vision: remove objects, the subject stands revealed. Even amid knower/knowable agitation, devotees see easily (*sudṛśanaḥ*) — ease contrasts yogic difficulty (anticipates 16–17).

chunks.sanskrit: anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā aviyuktāsti te tadvad ekā tvadbhaktir astu me
chunks.l1:
## s01-v09 (9)
of-endless-bliss / lake / goddess / beloved / as / inseparable / exists / from-You / thus / one / Your-devotion / may-it-be / mine // UtSst_1.9
chunks.l2: As the lake of endless bliss, the Goddess, the beloved, is inseparable from You — so may one devotion of mine be inseparable.
chunks.l3:
As the Goddess — endless-bliss lake, dearest — stands unparted from You,
so may one love of mine stand — unparted.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v09 — argument map

*anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā.* As the beloved Goddess is inseparable from You, so may one devotion be mine. The devotee asks for non-separation modeled on the divine couple itself.

chunks.sanskrit: sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho saṃvinmārgo 'yam āhlādaduḥkhamohais tridhā sthitaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s01-v10 (10)
all / indeed / of-gaining-You / cause / of-bhakti-possessors / O-all-pervading / consciousness-path / this / with-joy / suffering / delusion / threefold / standing // UtSst_1.10
chunks.l2: O All-pervading — for devotees of devotion, everything is a cause of gaining You. This path of consciousness stands threefold — in joy, in suffering, in delusion.
chunks.l3:
O All — for lovers, everything causes the gaining of You.
This knowing-road stands threefold: by joy, by sorrow, by bewilderment.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v10 — argument map

*sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho.* For devotees everything causes gain of You; the consciousness-path stands threefold in joy, suffering, delusion. All three guṇa-states become path — nothing excluded.

chunks.sanskrit: bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā daśā sā māṃ prati svāmin nāsavasyeva śuktatā
chunks.l1:
## s01-v11 (11)
of-Your-devotion / nectar / by-tasting / of-knowledge / may-there-be / supreme / even / that / state / that / toward-me / with-respect-to / O-Lord / of-vinegar / as-if / sourness // UtSst_1.11
chunks.l2: What of knowledge — even its supreme state, from tasting Your devotion's nectar — is to me, O Lord, like vinegar-sourness after wine.
chunks.l3:
From tasting Your love's nectar, Master — even knowing's highest state
turns in my mouth to unwine-sourness.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v11 — argument map

*bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā daśā.* Even the supreme state of knowledge tastes, to me, like vinegar-sourness after wine beside devotion-nectar. Knowledge is not denied; it is out-tasted. (Lakshmanjoo's "Have you ever tasted liquor?" — the verse demands experience, not assent.)

chunks.sanskrit: bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā vidyāvidyobhayasyāpi tā ete tattvavedinaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s01-v12 (12)
of-Your-devotion / great-knowledge / of-those / to-practice / has-come / of-knowledge / of-non-knowledge / of-both / even / those / these / knowers-of-truth // UtSst_1.12
chunks.l2: Those to whom the great knowledge of Your devotion has come through practice — they alone know truth, both knowledge and its absence.
chunks.l3:
Those to whom Your love's great lore has come as practice —
they alone know the real: knowing, unknowing, both.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v12 — argument map

*bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā.* Those who have practiced devotion's great knowledge discriminate knowledge from non-knowledge. Discrimination is the fruit of practice, not its precondition (answers the scholar's objection).

chunks.sanskrit: āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī tvadbhaktisudhayā siktā tadrasāḍhyaphalāstu me
chunks.l1:
## s01-v13 (13)
from-the-root / speech / creeper / this / unfolding-in-sequence / possessing-expansion / by-Your-devotion-nectar / watered / of-that / with-rasa-rich / fruits / may-it-be / for-me // UtSst_1.13
chunks.l2: From the root, this creeper of speech, unfolding in due sequence — watered by the nectar of Your devotion, may it bear rasa-rich fruit for me.
chunks.l3:
This speech-creeper, from the root, opening in order —
sprinkled with Your love's nectar, may its fruit swell with that sap — for me.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v13 — argument map

*āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī.* The speech-creeper, unfolding in sequence from the root, watered by devotion-nectar — may it fruit for me. Speech itself grows and fruits; mantra is organic, not mechanical.

- Mark supplied in L2.

chunks.sanskrit: śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate tvam eva hi vapuḥ sāraṃ bhaktair advayaśodhitam
chunks.l1:
## s01-v14 (14)
Śiva / having-become / let-him-worship / thus / devotee / having-become / thus / is-said / You / indeed / for / body / essence / by-devotees / by-nonduality / purified // UtSst_1.14
chunks.l2: "Having become Śiva, let him worship" — so the devotee is said to have become. For You alone are the body's essence, purified by devotees through non-duality.
chunks.l3:
Be Śiva, then sacrifice — and the lover, become, is so declared.
For You alone are the body's pith, assayed by lovers in oneness.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v14 — argument map

*śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate.* "Having become Śiva, let him worship" — and the devotee is *said* to have become. Scripture's paradox resolved by reported transformation: the Veda declares the devotee already become, and the body is refined by non-dual examination (*advayaśodhitam*).

chunks.sanskrit: bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ tadasiddhyai nikṛṣṭānāṃ kāni nāvaraṇāni vā
chunks.l1:
## s01-v15 (15)
of-devotees / of-nonduality-with-You / for-accomplishment / what / not / proofs / for-its-non-accomplishment / of-the-low / what / not / obstructions / indeed // UtSst_1.15
chunks.l2: For devotees, what is not a means to accomplishment of non-duality with You? And for the low, what obstructions could there be to its failure?
chunks.l3:
For lovers, what is not proof toward oneness with You?
And for the lowest, what veil could dam its failing?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v15 — argument map

*bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ.* For devotees, what is not a means to non-duality with You? Even going astray leads there (Lakshmanjoo). And for the low, what obstructions to its failure? Double assurance: no wrong way, no blocked person.

### Open
- v.15 *nikṛṣṭānāṃ... kāni nāvaraṇāni* — "obstructions for the low": genuine universality or rhetorical assurance? Open; do not systematize.

chunks.sanskrit: kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā anyathā sarvakakṣyāsu bhāsi bhaktimatāṃ katham
chunks.l1:
## s01-v16 (16)
sometime / somewhere / attainable / you-are / by-yoga / thus / O-Lord / deceit / otherwise / in-all-states / you-shine / of-bhakti-possessors / how // UtSst_1.16
chunks.l2: That You are attained sometime, somewhere, by yoga, O Lord — that is the deceit. Otherwise, how would You shine in all states for the possessors of devotion?
chunks.l3:
Some time, some place, by yoga You may be got — Lord, that's the cheat.
Else how do You shine, here blazing, in every state, for lovers?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v16 — argument map

*kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā.* Attained sometime, somewhere, by yoga (thought-constriction, e.g., in the heart-wheel — Kṣemarāja) — this is **the deceit**. Proof: otherwise how do You shine in ALL states, including post-samādhi emergence, for devotees? The polemic verse: localization refutes itself.

chunks.sanskrit: pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam yogibhyo bhaktibhājām yad vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ
chunks.l1:
## s01-v17 (17)
by-withdrawal / etc. / untouched / distinction / exists / great / this / than-yogins / of-devotion-sharers / since / in-emergence / even / composed // UtSst_1.17
chunks.l2: Untouched by withdrawal and the rest — this is the great distinction: that sharers of devotion stay composed even in emergence, beyond the yogins.
chunks.l3:
Untouched by breath-withdrawal and the rest — this is the great difference:
devotion's portion-takers stay gathered even waking — past the yogins.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v17 — argument map

*pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam.* The great distinction, untouched by withdrawal etc.: devotees stay composed even in emergence (*vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ*), yogins do not. The test is not ecstasy but return.

chunks.sanskrit: na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate amāye śivamārge 'smin bhaktir ekā praśasyate
chunks.l1:
## s01-v18 (18)

chunks.l2: No yoga is enjoined, no austerity, no procedure of worship at all. On this guileless path of Śiva, devotion alone is praised.
chunks.l3:
No yoga bidden, no self-burning, no rite-rule — none of it prescribed.
On this straight Śiva-road, love alone is praised.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v18 — argument map

*na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate.* No yoga, no austerity, no worship-procedure is enjoined; on this guileless Śiva-path, devotion alone is praised. The amāya (guileless) path needs no technique because its means is love.

chunks.sanskrit: sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama pratyakṣasarvabhāvasya cintānām api naśyatu

## s01-v19 (19)
from-all-sides / by-shining / devotion / light / of-shattered / covering / of-me / of-directly-faced / all-things / of-thoughts / even / may-perish // UtSst_1.19
chunks.l2: My covering shattered by devotion's light shining from all sides — may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish.
chunks.l3:
My cover fire-shattered from all sides by love's play of light —

chunks.argmap:
## s01-v19 — argument map

*sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama.* My covering shattered by all-radiant devotion-light; may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish. Covering destroyed from all sides at once — then even thought, facing reality directly, ends.

### Open
- v.19 *cintānām api naśyatu* — whose thoughts perish, and is thought's end extinction or facing (*pratyakṣa*)? Left open.

chunks.sanskrit: śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā samastaviṣayāsvādo bhakteṣv evāsti ko 'py aho
chunks.l1:
## s01-v20 (20)
Śiva / thus / of-one-word / of-tongue / on-tip / standing / always / of-all / sense-objects / taste / in-devotees / indeed / exists / what / even / wonder // UtSst_1.20
chunks.l2: A wonder: that in devotees, with the single word "Śiva" standing always on the tongue's tip, there is the taste of every sense-object.
chunks.l3:
One word — Śiva — camped on the tongue-tip, always — and every sense-thing tasted.
In lovers only. Whatever that is — ah!
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v20 — argument map

*śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā.* The single word "Śiva" standing always on the tongue-tip: devotees taste by it every sense-object — a wonder (*aho*). The Name delivers all senses, not just sound. (Lakshmanjoo: nectar of touch, embrace, smell — ethically risky rendering; keep to "every sense-object's taste" in L2.)

### Open
- v.20 Lakshmanjoo's sensory expansion (touch/embrace/smell) exceeds the text's *samastaviṣayāsvāda*; rein in L2.

## s01-v21 (21)

*śāntakallolaśītācchasvādubhaktisudhāmbudhau.* Who counts as low who stands firm tasting the unworldly rasa, diving the calm-waved cool sweet devotion-milk-ocean? Status inverted: divers, not scholars, rank high.

## s01-v22 (22)
by-equals / why / not / should-be-chewed / Your-devotion / great-medicine / such / O-Lord / of-which / liberation-named / uninterrupted / rasa // UtSst_1.22
chunks.l2: Why would people like me not chew Your devotion's great medicine — whose after-taste, O Lord, is called liberation?
chunks.l3:
Why would the likes of us not chew Your love's great herb —
such a one whose very next taste, Lord, is called freedom?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v22 — argument map

*sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ.* Why would people like me not chew devotion's great medicine — whose after-taste is named liberation? Medicine, not dessert: it cures, with liberation as after-taste (*anantara rasa*), not wages.

chunks.sanskrit: tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ tvad bhaktirasasambhogavisrambhaparipoṣikāḥ

chunks.l2: Those alone are ultimately wealth, O Lord, in the judgement of the good — which nourish confident enjoyment of the taste of devotion to You.
chunks.l3:

whatever fattens trusted feasting on Your love's sap.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v23 — argument map

*tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ.* True wealth, the good agree, is only what nourishes confident enjoyment of devotion-nectar. Wealth redefined: whatever feeds enjoyment of the rasa.

*bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ.* They have grasped devotion-nectar's essence who, fallen even into passion's mud, are not smeared. Falling without staining: the world entered without adhesion.

## s01-v25 (25)
among-powers-beginning-with-aṇimā / ending-with-liberation / among-limbs / indeed / fruit / called / of-Your-devotion / of-ripened / of-creeper / as-it-were / in-some / indeed // UtSst_1.25
chunks.l2: From supernormal powers to liberation — fruit is named as a mere limb of the ripened creeper of Your devotion, for some.
chunks.l3:
Powers down to freedom — fruit is just a limb-name on love's ripe creeper.
In some.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v25 — argument map

*aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā.* From supernormal powers to liberation, fruits are named as mere limbs of the ripened devotion-creeper — for some. Even liberation is a limb, not the root; the creeper is the thing.

## s01-v26 (26)
wonder / by-nature / O-Lord / of-pain / seed / this / mind / by-Your-devotion-rasa / watered / of-liberation / great-fruit // UtSst_1.26
chunks.l2: A wonder, Lord: this mind, by nature pain's seed — watered by the essence of devotion to You, becomes liberation's great fruit.
chunks.l3:
Strange, Lord: this mind, pain-seed by nature — sprinkled with Your love's sap,
ripens into freedom's great fruit.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v26 — argument map

*citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ.* Wonder: the mind, by nature pain's seed, watered by devotion-rasa becomes liberation's great fruit.

chunks.sanskrit: agnīṣomaravibrahmaviṣṇusthāvarajaṅgama svarūpa bahurūpāya namaḥ saṃvinmayāya te

## s02-v01 (1)
of-fire-moon-sun-Brahmā-Viṣṇu-moving-unmoving / of-own-nature / to-many-formed / bow / of-consciousness-formed / to-You // UtSst_2.1
chunks.l2: To the many-formed, whose nature is consciousness — fire, moon, sun, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, moving and unmoving — bow.
chunks.l3:
Fire, moon, sun — Brahmā, Viṣṇu — still things, moving things: Your very stuff.
To the many-shaped — to You, shaped of knowing — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v01 — argument map

Fire-moon-sun, Brahmā-Viṣṇu, moving-unmoving: to the many-formed, consciousness-formed — bow. The All invoked as elements AND gods at once; multiplicity is the address, not the problem.

chunks.sanskrit: viśvendhanamahākṣārānulepaśucivarcase mahānalāya bhavate viśvaikahaviṣe namaḥ

## s02-v02 (2)
of-universe-fuel-great-ash-smeared-pure-shining / to-great-fire / to-Becoming / of-world-sole-oblation / bow // UtSst_2.2
chunks.l2: To the great fire fed by the universe as fuel, smeared-pure with great ash, to the Becoming to whom the world is the sole oblation — bow.
chunks.l3:
To the great fire — universe for fuel, bright with great ash smeared pure —
to Thee, the Becoming, whose one offering is the world — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v02 — argument map

To the great fire fed by the universe as fuel, smeared-pure, the world's sole oblation. Sacrifice internalized: the world is fuel, the fire is Him.

chunks.sanskrit: paramāmṛtasāndrāya śītalāya śivāgnaye kasmai cid viśvasaṃploṣaviṣamāya namo 'stu te

## s02-v03 (3)
to-supreme-nectar-dense / to-cool / to-Śiva-fire / to-some / even / of-world-destroying-unequal / bow / be / to-You // UtSst_2.3
chunks.l2: To Śiva-fire — cool, dense with supreme nectar — and to You, the unequalled devourer in the world's destruction — bow.
chunks.l3:
To Śiva's fire — cool, thick with highest nectar —
and to some Unequalled, all-devouring when the world burns — homage be to Thee.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v03 — argument map

To Śiva-fire: cool, supremely nectar-dense — and to You, the unequalled devourer of all. Coolness and devouring together; comfort and terror in one flame. (Lakshmanjoo ch.2 v.28 excerpt source.)

chunks.sanskrit: mahādevāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te maheśvarāyāpi namaḥ kasmai cin mantramūrtaye

## s02-v04 (4)
to-Mahādeva / to-Rudra / to-Śaṅkara / to-Śiva / to-You / to-Maheśvara-even / bow / to-which / indeed / mantra-formed / bow // UtSst_2.4
chunks.l2: To Mahādeva, to Rudra, to Śaṅkara, to Śiva, to You Maheśvara — and to someone mantra-bodied — bow.
chunks.l3:
To Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva — to Thee, even as Great-Lord — bow.
And to some mantra-bodied one — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v04 — argument map

To Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva, Maheśvara — and to some mantra-bodied one. Named gods PLUS the unnamed ("someone mantra-formed"): the list refuses closure.

## s02-v05 (5)
bow / of-cut-dried-up-three-worlds-melted-fat-pouring-unequalled / to-auspicious / to-Śiva-fire // UtSst_2.5
chunks.l2: To Śiva-fire — cut, dried up, the three worlds' melted fat the oblation — unequalled, yet auspicious — bow.
chunks.l3:
Bow — to Śiva's fire: cut, sucked dry, the three worlds' melted fat His unction —
unequalled though He be, yet kind.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v05 — argument map

To Śiva-fire: cut, dried up, the three worlds' melted fat the offering — unequalled, yet auspicious. Destruction language, auspiciousness kept.

## s02-v06 (6)
of-all-marks-meeting / indeed / of-which / mark / to-him / bow / be / to-god / to-some / indeed / to-Śambhu // UtSst_2.6
chunks.l2: To the god — to gracious someone — for whom the meeting of all marks is itself the mark — bow.
chunks.l3:
Whose mark is this alone — that no marks meet —
to Him, to God, to gracious some Śambhu — homage be.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v06 — argument map

To the god — to someone gracious — whose mark is just the non-meeting of all marks. The sign of Him: signlessness. (Lakshmanjoo: "perceiving Him in no way.")

chunks.sanskrit: vedāgamaviruddhāya vedāgamavidhāyine vedāgamasatattvāya guhyāya svāmine namaḥ

## s02-v07 (7)
to-Veda-āgama-opposing / to-Veda-āgama-making / to-Veda-āgama-true-essence / to-hidden / to-master / bow // UtSst_2.7
chunks.l2: To the hidden Lord — Veda-and-Āgama-opposing, Veda-and-Āgama-making, their true essence, secret master — bow.
chunks.l3:
To Him against Veda and Āgama, maker of Veda and Āgama, their true essence —
to the hidden Master — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v07 — argument map

To the hidden Lord: Veda-opposing AND Veda-making, Veda's true essence, secret master. Scripture's author and its transgressor at once.

chunks.sanskrit: saṃsāraikanimittāya saṃsāraikavirodhine namaḥ samsārarūpāya niḥsaṃsārāya śambhave

## s02-v08 (8)
of-saṃsāra-sole-cause / of-saṃsāra-sole-foe / bow / of-saṃsāra-formed / of-saṃsāra-free / to-Śambhu // UtSst_2.8
chunks.l2: Sole cause of the wheel of births and deaths — and its sole opponent; saṃsāra-formed, saṃsāra-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
chunks.l3:
Sole maker of the world-round — and its sole unmaker;
round-shaped, round-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v08 — argument map

Sole cause of saṃsāra AND its sole opponent; saṃsāra-formed AND saṃsāra-free. Fourfold contradiction in one breath; the cause/foe pair is the engine verse. (Lakshmanjoo: "the only cause... of this torture.")

chunks.sanskrit: mūlāya madhyāyāgrāya mūlamadhyāgramūrtaye kṣīnāgramadhyamūlāya namaḥ pūrṇāya śambhave

## s02-v09 (9)
to-root / to-middle / to-tip / to-root-middle-tip-formed / to-tip-middle-root-dissolved / bow / to-full / to-Śambhu // UtSst_2.9
chunks.l2: To root, to middle, to tip; embodied as root-middle-tip; with tip-middle-root exhausted — to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
chunks.l3:
To root, middle, tip; shaped as root-middle-tip; tip-middle-root outworn —
to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v09 — argument map

To root, middle, tip; embodied as root-middle-tip; with tip-middle-root exhausted; to the Full. Time's three points run forward, then backward, then out — exhaustion as fullness.

chunks.sanskrit: namaḥ sukṛtasaṃbharavipākaḥ sakṛd apy asau yasya nāmagrahas tasmai durlabhāya śivāya te

## s02-v10 (10)
bow / of-merit-heap-ripening / even-once / also / also / of-whom / by-name-taking / to-him / hard-to-find / to-Śiva / to-You // UtSst_2.10
chunks.l2: Even once — whosever taking of the Name — ripened heaps of merit. To You, Śiva, hard to attain — bow.
chunks.l3:
Bow — that taking of the Name, even once, IS merit-heaps ripened.
To Him, Śiva, hard to win — to Thee.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v10 — argument map

Even once, whoever takes His name: ripened merit-heaps. Grace-economics: a single utterance outbids accumulated merit; rarity (*durlabha*) with open access.

## s02-v11 (11)
bow / with-moving-unmoving-multitude-heaps / always / sporting / to-You-alone / one / to-consciousness-formed / to-skull-bearer // UtSst_2.11
chunks.l2: To You alone — consciousness-formed, skull-bearing — ever sporting with heaped multitudes of moving-and-static forms — bow.
chunks.l3:
Bow — amid heaped crowds of moving and unmoving shapes, ever playing for Thee, the One —
knowing-shaped, skull-wearing.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v11 — argument map

To the One playing, consciousness-formed, skull-bearing, with multitudes of moving-static forms ever heaped around. Play (*krīḍā*) as His mode; the skull-bearer amid crowds, not apart.

## s02-v12 (12)
to-magician / to-pure / to-hidden / to-self-manifest / to-subtle / to-all-formed / bow / to-wondrous / to-Śambhu // UtSst_2.12
chunks.l2: To the magician, the pure, the hidden, the self-manifest; the subtle, the all-formed — to wondrous Śambhu — bow.
chunks.l3:
To the trickster, the pure; the hidden, the self-shown; the fine, the all-shaped — bow —
to Śambhu, wonder-variegated.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v12 — argument map

Magician yet pure, hidden yet self-manifest, subtle yet all-formed — to wondrous Śambhu, bow. Six paradoxes, no resolution offered; the list IS the theology.

by-Brahmā-Indra-Viṣṇu-arrayed / world-destroying-play / to-wonder-working / bow / to-You / O-all-power // UtSst_2.13
chunks.l2: To all power — whose play destroys the world arrayed by Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu — wonder-working — bow.
chunks.l3:
To all-might — whose sport unmakes the world arrayed by Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu —
wonder to be worked — bow to Thee.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v13 — argument map

To all-power: Brahmā-Viṣṇu-arrayed world's destroyer-play, wonder-working. Destruction as play (*kelī*), not wrath.

## s02-v14 (14)
on-shores / indeed / by-wandering / gained / those / those / powers / of-whom / to-him / bow / to-You / O-unfathomable-Hara-ocean // UtSst_2.14
chunks.l2: To You, the fathomless Hara-ocean — whose powers are gained by those wandering only its shores — bow.
chunks.l3:
Those powers and powers are won by shore-roamers only — roamers of His shores.
Bow to Thee — O fathomless Hara-sea.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v14 — argument map

To the fathomless Hara-ocean: powers gained only by those wandering its shores. Stay on the shore — the powers are littoral, the ocean itself is beyond grasping. (Lakshmanjoo: "unlimited ocean... on whose shores.")

chunks.l2: To the lovely hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus, dwelling mid mud of the Māyā-made dense world, unsmeared, shining — bow.
chunks.l3:
Dwelling deep in the mud of the Māyā-thick world — unsmeared —
bow to the shining hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v15 — argument map

Dwelling mid mud of the Māyā-made dense world, unsmeared — to lovely hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus. Cf. 1.24's unstained; the lotus gives the image.

## s02-v16 (16)
to-auspicious / to-pure / to-treasure / to-ornament-self / to-dear / to-supreme-real / to-highest / to-You / bow // UtSst_2.16
chunks.l2: Auspicious, pure, treasure, self-ornamented; dear, ultimate-real, highest — to You — bow.
chunks.l3:
To the kind, the pure; treasure; self-adorned; dear; last-real; highest —
to Thee — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v16 — argument map

Auspicious, pure, treasure, self-ornamented; dear, ultimate-real, highest — bow. Pure auspiciousness catalogue; no paradox this time — rest before the hard verses.

## s02-v17 (17)
bow / to-ever-bound / to-ever-freedom-sharing / to-bondage-freedom-less / to-whomsoever / indeed / even / also / to-Śambhu // UtSst_2.17
chunks.l2: Ever bound, ever sharing liberation's portion; difference-free — to gracious someone Śambhu — bow.
chunks.l3:
Bow to the ever-bound, ever sharing freedom; lacking bond and freedom both —
to some Śambhu even — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v17 — argument map

To ever-bound AND ever-liberated; to difference-free gracious Śambhu. The stanza's impossibility held without blinking. (Lakshmanjoo's stressed paradox.)

## s02-v18 (18)
in-mockery-essence-only / in-this / in-all-this / in-three-worlds / to-You-alone / indeed / to-non-dual / bow / to-ever-bliss-seated // UtSst_2.18
chunks.l2: In these three worlds whose essence is mockery alone — to You alone, secondless, ever-bliss-seated — bow.
chunks.l3:
In all this three-world, whose whole stuff is jeering —
to Thee alone, secondless, ever throned in bliss — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v18 — argument map

In these three worlds whose essence is mockery alone — to You, secondless, ever-bliss-seated. The world demoted to joke; He alone serious.

chunks.sanskrit: dakṣiṇācārasārāya vāmācārābhilāṣiṇe sarvācārāya śarvāya nirācārāya te namaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s02-v19 (19)
of-right-practice-essence / of-left-practice-desiring / to-all-practices / to-Śarva / to-practiceless / to-You / bow // UtSst_2.19
chunks.l2: Essence of right-observance yet desirer of left-observance; of all observances, to observance-free Śarva — bow.
chunks.l3:
Heart of right-rite, lover of left-rite; all-rite, Śarva, rite-free —
to Thee — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v19 — argument map

Essence of right-observance yet desirer of left-observance; of all observances, observance-free. Rites affirmed and exceeded in one line. (Lakshmanjoo: "essence of dakṣiṇācāra.")

## s02-v20 (20)
as / however / who / worshipped / where / there / even / who / worshipped / who / even / or / he / even / or / who / that / god / to-him / bow / be / to-You // UtSst_2.20
chunks.l2: Whoever is worshipped, however, wherever — and whoever, whatever god he be — to that god, bow.
chunks.l3:
Be it how it may — whoever is worshipped, wherever honored — whoever, whichever god that be —
to him let homage be: to Thee.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v20 — argument map

Whoever worshipped, however, wherever, whatever god — to that god, bow. Total ritual hospitality: no wrong address, since all reach Him.

chunks.sanskrit: mumukṣujanasevyāya sarvasantāpahāriṇe namo vitatalāvaṇyavarāya varadāya te

## s02-v21 (21)
by-liberation-seekers-served / of-all-burning-removing / bow / to-spread-loveliness-best / to-boon-giving / to-You // UtSst_2.21
chunks.l2: Served by liberation-seekers, remover of all burning; of spread-out chosen loveliness — to You, boon-giver — bow.
chunks.l3:
Served by release-hungers, thief of every fever; spread loveliness at its choicest —
boon-giver — bow to Thee.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v21 — argument map

Served by liberation-seekers, remover of all burning; of spread-out chosen loveliness, boon-giver. Austerity (tapas-heat) cooled by beauty.

chunks.sanskrit: sadā nirantarānandarasanirbharitākhila- trilokāya namas tubhyaṃ svāmine nityaparvaṇe

## s02-v22 (22)
always / of-unbroken-bliss-rasa-filled-all-three-worlds / bow / to-You / O-Lord / of-ever-festival // UtSst_2.22
chunks.l2: To You, Lord of the ever-festival, whose three worlds brim with unbroken bliss-rasa — bow.
chunks.l3:
Always — three worlds brimmed with unbroken bliss-sap —
bow to Thee, Master of the feast that never ends.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v22 — argument map

To the Lord of the ever-festival, whose three worlds brim with unbroken bliss-rasa. Festival not occasion but ontology.

chunks.sanskrit: sukhapradhānasaṃvedyasambhogair bhajate ca yat tvām eva tasmai ghorāya śaktivṛndāya te namaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s02-v23 (23)
of-pleasure-first / knowables-enjoying / worships / and / which / You / indeed / to-that / terrible / host-of-powers / to-You / bow // UtSst_2.23
chunks.l2: Whatever enjoys You through pleasure-first knowables — to that terrible host of Your powers — bow.
chunks.l3:
Whatever courts Thee — Thee indeed — through pleasure-first tastes, enjoying —
to that dread power-ring of Thine — homage to Thee.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v23 — argument map

What enjoys You in pleasure-first knowables — to that terrible host of powers, bow. Striking turn: salutation redirected from Him to His terrible energies who enjoy Him. Devotion includes the fearful retinue.

chunks.sanskrit: munīnām apy avijñeyaṃ bhaktisambandhaceṣṭitāḥ āliṅganty api yaṃ tasmai kasmai cid bhavate namaḥ

## s02-v24 (24)
of-sages / even / unknown / devotion-touched / gestures / embrace / even / whom / to-that / to-some / indeed / to-Becoming / bow // UtSst_2.24
chunks.l2: Even sages cannot know Him — yet those whose gestures love connects embrace Him. To that someone Becoming — bow.
chunks.l3:
Past even sages' knowing — yet those love-yoked in gesture hold Him fast.
To that some Becoming — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v24 — argument map

Even sages cannot know Him — yet those whose gestures LOVE connects embrace Him. To that someone, bow. Knowing fails; embracing works; love outranks asceticism. (Anticipates 1.17's yogin/devotee cut from the other side.)

chunks.sanskrit: paramāmṛtakośāya paramāmṛtarāśaye sarvapāramyapāramyaprāpyāya bhavate namaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s02-v25 (25)
of-supreme-nectar / store / of-supreme-nectar / heap / of-all / of-beyond / of-non-beyond / to-be-reached / to-Becoming / bow // UtSst_2.25
chunks.l2: To the supreme-nectar sheath, the supreme-nectar heap; reachable beyond far and near — to Becoming — bow.
chunks.l3:
To highest-nectar's sheath, highest-nectar's heap;
reached past all beyond and no-beyond — to Becoming — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v25 — argument map

To the supreme-nectar sheath, supreme-nectar heap, reachable beyond far and near. Nectar stored AND heaped; distance categories collapse.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v26 (26)
made-of-great-mantra / I-praise / form / of-You / clear-cool / unprecedented-joy-fortunate / supreme-nectar-juicy // UtSst_2.26
chunks.l2: I praise Your mantra-formed, clear-cool, unprecedentedly joyful, supreme-nectar-juicy form.
chunks.l3:
Mantra through and through — I praise Thy form:
clear, cool, lovely with unheard joy, lush with highest-nectar sap.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v26 — argument map

I praise Your mantra-formed, clear-cool, unprecedentedly joyful, supreme-nectar-juicy form. The mantra IS His body; praise of form is praise of sound.

## s02-v27 (27)
of-autonomy-nectar-full / of-oneness-fame / in-great-cloth / wonder / not / is / indeed / where / O-Lord / that / I-praise / Your / teaching // UtSst_2.27
chunks.l2: On oneness-fame's great cloth, full of immortality-nectar — where, Lord, there is no wonder — I praise Your teaching.
chunks.l3:
On oneness-fame's wide canvas, grounded in freedom-nectar's fullness —
where, Lord, wonder simply isn't — that I praise: Thy teaching.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v27 — argument map

On oneness-fame's great cloth, full of immortality-nectar — where, Lord, there is no wonder — I praise Your teaching. Non-wonder as doctrine: once oneness is spread out, marvels stop being marvelous.

chunks.sanskrit: sarvāśaṅkāsaniṃ sarvālakṣmīkālānalaṃ tathā sarvāmaṅgalyakalpāntaṃ mārgaṃ māheśvaraṃ numaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s02-v28 (28)
of-all-doubts-thunderbolt / to-all-misfortune-world-end-fire / likewise / of-all-inauspicious-ending / path / of-Maheśvara / we-bow // UtSst_2.28
chunks.l2: Thunderbolt to all doubt, world-end fire to all misfortune, world's-end to all joylessness — we bow the Māheśvara path.
chunks.l3:
Thunderbolt to every doubt, doomsday-fire to all ill-luck, aeon-end to joylessness —
we bow the Great-Lord road.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v28 — argument map

Thunderbolt to all doubt, world-end fire to all misfortune, world's-end to all joylessness — we bow the Māheśvara path. The path itself praised as weapon; protection by awe. (Swamiji, Hymns to Shiva ch2 v28: alakṣmī is poverty; stepping on the path ends doubt, misfortune, joylessness at once.)

chunks.sanskrit: jaya deva namo namo 'stu te sakalaṃ viśvam idaṃ tavāśritam jagatāṃ parameśvaro bhavān paramekaḥ śaraṇāgato 'smi te
chunks.l1:
## s02-v29 (29)
victory / O-god / bow / bow / be / to-You / all / world / this / of-You / resting-on / of-worlds / O-supreme-Lord / You-are / supreme-one / to-refuge-gone / am / to-You // UtSst_2.29
chunks.l2: Victory, god! Bow upon bow to You; this whole world rests on You; of worlds You are supreme Lord; I am come to You for refuge, the One supreme.
chunks.l3:
Hail, God! Bow on bow to Thee; all this world leans on Thee;
Thou — worlds' high Lord, One supreme — I am come to Thee for shelter.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v29 — argument map

Victory, god! Bow upon bow to You; this whole world rests on You; of worlds You are supreme Lord; I am come to You for refuge, the One supreme. Litany closes into refuge (*śaraṇāgata*) — contemplation ends in surrender.

chunks.sanskrit: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave
chunks.l1:
## s03-v01 (1)
being / by-non-being-ness / of-beings / endowed / which / twofold / course / that / having-leapt-beyond / to-the-third / bow / to-the-wondrous / to-Śambhu // UtSst_3.1
chunks.l2: Of things, the two courses that go by being and non-being — leaping over them — to the third, the wondrous Śambhu — bow.
chunks.l3:
Things run double — being, unbeing, the two-yoked course.
Leap it. To the Third — bow to wondrous Śambhu.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v01 — argument map

*sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ.* The two courses of things — by being and non-being — leapt over; to the third, the wondrous Śambhu, bow. Method stated: transcendence by leap, not ladder.

chunks.sanskrit: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v02 (2)
of-gods / seer / from-men / in-this / in-the-unfree / world / in-triad / free / they / of-the-free / who / of-You / indeed / dependents // UtSst_3.2
chunks.l2: Among gods, seers, and men in this unfree triple world — free are Your dependents, O Free One.
chunks.l3:
Gods, seers, men — this triple world unfree.
But free are they who live off Thee alone, O Free — Thy hangers-on.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v02 — argument map

*āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye.* Among gods, seers, men in this unfree triple world — free are Your dependents, the Free One's own. Freedom is contagious, not achieved. (Lakshmanjoo: all dependent, Your men free.)

chunks.sanskrit: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v03 (3)
whole / universe / inlaid / Your / body / remembrance / of-whom / of-becoming / of-pains / one / medicine / they / happily / seated // UtSst_3.3
chunks.l2: Remembrance of Your body inlaid with the whole universe — the one medicine for world-pain; who have it sit happy.
chunks.l3:
Thy body, gem-set with the whole world —
remembering it: the one medicine for existence-pain. Who hold it, sit easy.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v03 — argument map

*aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ.* Remembrance of Your body inlaid with the whole universe — the sole medicine for world-pain; who have it sit happy. Memory as cure.

chunks.sanskrit: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v04 (4)
white / umbrella / of-whom / moon / own / light / filled / fly-whisk / heaven-river / stream / he / alone / supreme-lord // UtSst_3.4
chunks.l2: Whose white umbrella is the self-lit moon, whose fly-whisk the heaven-river's stream — He alone is Supreme Lord.
chunks.l3:
Whose white parasol is the moon, lit with its own light;
whose whisk is heaven-river's rush — He alone is high Lord.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v04 — argument map

*sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ.* Whose white umbrella is the self-lit moon, whose fly-whisk the heaven-river's stream — He alone is Supreme Lord. Cosmic regalia; kingship by metaphor.

chunks.sanskrit: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm
chunks.l1:
## s03-v05 (5)
luminous / cool / one / pure / moon / digit / as / glance / grant / to-me / O-Lord / some / even / nectar / bearing // UtSst_3.5
chunks.l2: Grant me, Lord, a glance — luminous, cool, one, pure as a moon-digit, carrying nectar.
chunks.l3:
Bright, cool, single, pure — like a moon-sliver —
deal me a glance, Lord, any at all, nectar-flowing.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v05 — argument map

*prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ... dṛśaṃ vitara me.* Grant me, Lord, a glance — luminous, cool, one, pure as moon-digit, carrying nectar. The begged glance; grace as look. (Lakshmanjoo: "I want only one glance of Thee.")

chunks.sanskrit: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v06 (6)
Your / consciousness / bliss / from-ocean / fallen / knowings / drops / these / why / for-me / O-Lord / not / nectar / taste / beautiful // UtSst_3.6
chunks.l2: Fallen from Your consciousness-bliss ocean — these knowings, these drops — why are they not nectar-sweet-beautiful to me, Lord?
chunks.l3:
Drops fallen from Thy knowing-bliss sea — these knowings —
why, Lord, in my mouth not nectar-sweet, not lovely?
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v06 — argument map

*tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ.* Drops fallen from Your consciousness-bliss ocean — these knowings — why aren't they nectar-sweet-beautiful to me? The devotee interrogates his own dryness.

chunks.sanskrit: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v07 (7)
in-You / love / in-rasa / O-Lord / not / merged / heart / O-ruler / of-whom / not / hearted / indeed / they / contempt / abode / such // UtSst_3.7
chunks.l2: In Your love-rasa, Lord, hearts unmelted — the heartless alone — such deserve contempt.
chunks.l3:
Hearts undipped in Thy love-sap, Lord —
whose are so, Master, are heartless, nothing else: such are contempt's seat.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v07 — argument map

*tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ.* Hearts unmelted in Your love-rasa are heartless indeed — fit for contempt. Hard verse: unmelted = contemptible. Do not soften.

chunks.sanskrit: prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam prābhavīṇāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paramekaḥ sa bhājanam
chunks.l1:
## s03-v08 (8)
by-the-lord / by-You / whose / arisen / heart / meeting / of-ruling-goddesses / of-powers / supreme / alone / he / vessel // UtSst_3.8
chunks.l2: Whose heart has met the Lord's — he alone is the vessel of ruling goddesses' powers.
chunks.l3:
Whose heart has met with Thine, Lord —
he, he alone, holds the ruling Ladies' powers: their one high vessel.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v08 — argument map

*prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam.* Whose heart met the Lord's — he alone is the vessel of ruling goddesses' powers. Union makes the devotee the gods' container — inversion of worship direction.

chunks.sanskrit: harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam bhavaddhyānāmṛtāpūro nimnāṇimnabhuvām iva
chunks.l1:
## s03-v09 (9)
of-joys / now / of-sorrows / of-all / flooder / alike / Your / meditation / nectar / flood / low / non-low / of-lands / as // UtSst_3.9
chunks.l2: Flooder alike of all joys and sorrows — Your meditation-nectar-flood, like lowlands filling.
chunks.l3:
Drowner of joys, then sorrows — all, alike —
Thy thought-nectar in flood, over low ground, as water seeks it.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v09 — argument map

*harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam.* Flooder alike of all joys and sorrows — Your meditation-nectar-flood, like lowlands filling. Feeling levelled, not sorted.

chunks.sanskrit: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā
chunks.l1:
## s03-v10 (10)
what / as-it-were / not / may-it-be / with-glance / of-them / happiness / provisions / full / of-whom / self / by-greater / O-Lord / not / where / even / separation / from-You // UtSst_3.10
chunks.l2: What would their look not be, happiness-provisions-full — who never part from You, more than self, Lord?
chunks.l3:
What would their eyes not hold, brimmed with joy-stores —
they who, by more than life, Lord, nowhere ever leave Thee?
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v10 — argument map

*keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā.* What would their look not be, happiness-provisions-full — who never part from You, more than self, Lord? Lifers (*ātmādhikena*...): separation impossible. (Lakshmanjoo: "more than their own lives.")

chunks.sanskrit: garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ svāmī mamaiṣa ghaṭito yat tvam atyantarocanaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v11 (11)
I-roar / ah / I-dance / fulfilled / of-me / mind / chariots / lord / my / this / won / since / you / utterly / charming // UtSst_3.11
chunks.l2: I roar, I dance — my wishes are fulfilled, for my Lord is won, utterly charming.
chunks.l3:
I thunder — ah! — I dance: my mind-chariots ride full, for my Master is won —
since Thou, Thou utterly delightest.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v11 — argument map

*garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ.* I roar, I dance — my wishes fulfilled, for my Lord is won, utterly charming. Ecstasy as evidence: roar and dance prove arrival.

chunks.sanskrit: nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo vidā ca yat jñānaṃ syāt kiṃ tu viśvaikapūrṇā cittvaṃ vijṛmbhate
chunks.l1:
## s03-v12 (12)
not / other / knowable / action / where / not / other / yoga / by-knowing / and / which / knowledge / may-it-be / what / but / universe / one / full / consciousness / you / expands // UtSst_3.12
chunks.l2: Where no other knowable for action, no other yoga for knowing — yet what if knowledge? Consciousness alone, world-filled-one, expands.
chunks.l3:
No other known for doing, no other yoke for knowing —
and yet, what of knowing? Thou — all-one-full Knowing — unfoldest.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v12 — argument map

*nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo.* Where no other knowable for action, no other yoga for knowing — yet what if knowledge? Consciousness alone, world-filled-one, expands. Anti-method peak: nothing to know, nowhere to yoke — and yet expansion.

chunks.sanskrit: durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te hastāt palāyitā yeṣāṃ vāci śaśvacchivadhvaniḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v13 (13)
hard / of-conquerable / of-endless / of-sorrows / suddenly / indeed / of-them / from-hand / fled / of-whom / in-speech / forever / Śiva / sound // UtSst_3.13
chunks.l2: Suddenly fled from them — hard, endless sorrows — whose speech forever holds the Śiva-sound.
chunks.l3:
Hard, endless pains — suddenly out of their grip, fled —
from whom? Those in whose speech rings ever the Śiva-din.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v13 — argument map

*durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te.* Suddenly fled from them — hard, endless sorrows — whose speech forever holds the Śiva-sound. The Name as exorcist; sorrows flee sound, not argument.

chunks.sanskrit: uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti yuṣmaccheṣaviśeṣitaḥ tvaṃ mahāpuruṣas tv eko niḥśeṣapuruṣāśrayaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v14 (14)
highest / person / other / is / You / by-remainder / distinguished / you / great / person / but / alone / remainderless / of-persons / support // UtSst_3.14
chunks.l2: Is there another, higher person, distinct by remaining Yours? You alone, great Person, support of all persons without remainder.
chunks.l3:
Is there another high One, marked by remaining Thine?
Thou alone art the great Person — shelter of persons, none left out.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v14 — argument map

*uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti.* Is there another, higher person, distinct by remaining Yours? You alone, great Person, support of all persons without remainder. No second — with the devotee-residue kept ("remaining Yours").

chunks.sanskrit: jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te jagatāṃ vibho saṃsārārṇava evaiṣa yeṣāṃ krīḍāmahāsaraḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v15 (15)
they-conquer / they / world / venerable / servants / Your / of-worlds / O-pervader / transmigration / ocean / indeed / this / of-whom / play / great / lake // UtSst_3.15
chunks.l2: Victorious, world-venerable, Your slaves, Lord — for whom this saṃsāra-ocean is a play-great-lake.
chunks.l3:
They win — Thy slaves, honored by the world, O world-pervader —
for whom this very passing-sea is a play-lake.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v15 — argument map

*jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te.* Victorious, world-venerable, Your slaves, Lord — for whom this saṃsāra-ocean is a play-great-lake. Ocean shrunk to lake by servitude. (Lakshmanjoo's "victorious... Thy slaves.")

chunks.sanskrit: āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām tvam eva prakaṭībhūyā ity anenaiva lajjyate
chunks.l1:
## s03-v16 (16)
let-sit / meanwhile / other / miseries / here / You / of-devotees / you / indeed / manifest / may-you-be / thus / by-this / indeed / is-shamed // UtSst_3.16
chunks.l2: Let other miseries sit — for Your devotees, "You manifest Yourself" — by this alone they are shamed.
chunks.l3:
Let other miseries sit a while —
here, for Thy partakers, appear plain, Thou — by that alone they are shamed.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v16 — argument map

*āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām.* Let other miseries sit — for Your devotees, "You manifest Yourself" — by this alone they are shamed. His manifestation shames misery; no refutation needed.

chunks.sanskrit: matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ tattvena japa ity akṣamālayā diśasi kvacit
chunks.l1:
## s03-v17 (17)
than-me / beyond / not / is / therein / even / reciter / I-am / that / by-oneness / in-truth / recitation / thus / beads / by-rosary / you-point / where / indeed // UtSst_3.17
chunks.l2: "Nothing is beyond me" — yet therein I am a reciter, by that oneness; as truth, You point the rosary somewhere.
chunks.l3:
'Naught beyond me' — yet even there I tell my beads, one with that.
In truth: 'murmur on' — with bead-strand Thou pointest onward.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v17 — argument map

*matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ.* "Nothing is beyond me" — yet therein I am a reciter, by that oneness; as truth, You point the rosary somewhere. Recitation continues inside supremacy; the rosary pointed by Him.

chunks.sanskrit: sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat sac ca tasmāt paraṃ prabho tvaṃ cāsataḥ sataś cānyas tenāsi sadasanmayaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s03-v18 (18)
of-being / necessarily / supreme / being / being / and / than-that / beyond / O-ruler / you / and / from-non-being / of-being / and / other / therefore / you-are / being / non-being / formed // UtSst_3.18
chunks.l2: From being must come supreme being, and beyond that, Lord — and You are other than being and non-being both; hence You are being-non-being-formed.
chunks.l3:
From being, needs must, highest being — and being past even that, Lord. And Thou —
other than being, other than unbeing — so art Thou being-unbeing-stuff.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v18 — argument map

*sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat.* From being must come supreme being, and beyond that, Lord — and You are other than being and non-being both; hence You are being-non-being-formed. The metaphysical knot, tied openly. Do not untie in L2.

chunks.sanskrit: sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān api tvaṃ sarvabhuvanavyāpako 'pi na dṛśyase
chunks.l1:
## s03-v19 (19)
thousand / sun / ray / exceeding / pure / shining / even / you / all / worlds / pervading / even / not / you-are-seen // UtSst_3.19
chunks.l2: Purer-shining than thousand-sun-ray-rise — yet You, all-worlds-pervading, are not seen.
chunks.l3:
Purer-bright than a thousand suns raying up —
yet Thou, though through all worlds spread, art not seen.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v19 — argument map

*sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān.* Purer-shining than thousand-sun-ray-rise — yet You, all-worlds-pervading, are not seen. Maximum light, zero visibility: the paradox of immanence. (Lakshmanjoo's stressed verse.)

chunks.sanskrit: jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ vibhur mite ca yenāsi tena sarvottamo bhavān
chunks.l1:
## s03-v20 (20)
in-the-inert / in-the-world / consciousness / formed / indeed / in-the-knowable / even / knower / mighty / in-the-measured / and / by-which / you-are / by-that / all / highest / you // UtSst_3.20
chunks.l2: Conscious-formed in the inert world, knower even in the known; great in the measured — hence You are the highest.
chunks.l3:
Knowing-shaped in the dead world, they say —
knower inside the known; mighty in the measured: since Thou art so — highest of all, Lord.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v20 — argument map

*jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ.* Conscious-formed in the inert world, knower even in the known; great in the measured — hence You are the highest. Pervasion logic: great-by-containing, not by exceeding.

chunks.sanskrit: alam ākranditair anyair iyad eva puraḥ prabhoḥ tīvraṃ viraumi yan nātha muhyāmy evaṃ vidann api
chunks.l1:
## s03-v21 (21)
enough / with-cries / with-others / this-much / indeed / before / of-the-Lord / sharply / I-cry-aloud / which / O-Lord / I-am-bewildered / thus / knowing / even // UtSst_3.21
chunks.l2: Enough with other cries — this alone, before the Lord: I cry sharp, Lord, I am bewildered, even knowing thus.
chunks.l3:
Enough of other wailings — just this, before the Lord: I keen aloud —
for, Lord, I swoon, knowing even so.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v21 — argument map

*alam ākranditair anyair.* Enough with other cries — this alone, before the Lord: I cry sharp, Lord, I am bewildered, even knowing thus. Close: knowing bewilderment, crying anyway. (Lakshmanjoo: let other lamentations lie untouched.)

chunks.sanskrit: capalam asi yad api mānasa tatrāpi ślāghyase yato bhajase śaraṇānām api śaraṇaṃ tribhuvanagurum ambikākāntam
chunks.l1:
## s04-v01 (1)
fickle / you-are / since / even / O-mind / therein / even / you-are-praised / since / you-worship / of-refuges / even / refuge / triple-world / teacher / Ambikā / husband // UtSst_4.1
chunks.l2: Mind — though fickle you are — even so you are praised, since you worship the refuge of refuges, the world's teacher, Ambikā's husband.
chunks.l3:
Fickle though thou be, mind —
praised even so, since thou courtst the refuge of refuges, worlds' teacher, Ambikā's husband.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v01 — argument map

*capalam asi yad api mānasa.* Mind, though fickle — even so you are praised, since you worship the refuge of refuges, the world's teacher, Ambikā's husband. Fickleness forgiven for direction: praise for turning, not for steadiness. (Lakshmanjoo addresses his own mind throughout.)

chunks.sanskrit: ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam upeya śivacaraṇān āśrityāpy adharatarāṃ bhūmiṃ nādyāpi citram ujjhāmi
chunks.l1:
## s04-v02 (2)
having-crossed / various / gods / ladder / course / having-approached / Śiva / feet / having-resorted / even / lower / ground / not / now / even / wonder / I-quit // UtSst_4.2
chunks.l2: Having crossed the ladder-steps of the many gods and resorted to Śiva's feet — yet a lower ground I do not quit even now. Strange.
chunks.l3:
Stairs of sundry gods climbed past, Śiva's feet reached and held —
yet the low ground I keep even today. Strange — I quit it not.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v02 — argument map

*ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam.* Having crossed the ladder-steps of various gods, reached Śiva's feet — yet on the lowest ground I stand even now; wonder, I do not quit it. Arrival without departure: highest object, lowest seat, no contradiction felt.

chunks.sanskrit: prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām akhilalokacaritāni yāvad bhavāmi bhagavaṃs tava sapadi sadodito dāsaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s04-v03 (3)
reveal / own / path / hide / fully / all / world / doings / while / I-am / O-Lord / of-You / quickly / ever / risen / servant // UtSst_4.3
chunks.l2: Reveal Your own path, hide all world-ways thoroughly — while I am, Lord, quickly Your ever-risen servant.
chunks.l3:
Show Thine own road, shutter all world-doings tight —
while I am, Lord, Thy servant now, ever risen.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v03 — argument map

*prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām.* Reveal Your own path, hide all world-ways thoroughly — while I am, Lord, quickly Your ever-risen servant. Double imperative: show Yours, cover theirs; use me now (*sapadi*).

chunks.sanskrit: śiva śiva śambho śaṅkara śaraṇāgatavatsalāśu kuru karuṇām tava caraṇakamalayugalasmaraṇaparasya hi sampado 'dūre

## s04-v04 (4)

*bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ.* Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance? Dust as dye; dance as the question's form. (Lakshmanjoo: holding His feet, wiping their dust.)

chunks.sanskrit: tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā tvadantarvasatir mūko bhaveyaṃ mānyathā budhaḥ
chunks.l1:
## s05-v03 (3)
You / sole-Lord / O-Lord / this-much / indeed / I-ask / always / You / within / dwelling / silent / may-I-be / not / otherwise / wise // UtSst_5.3
chunks.l2: You, sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; not otherwise, O Wise One.
chunks.l3:
Thou my sole Lord — this much alone I beg, ever: dumb, dwelling inside Thee may I be —
never a sage instead.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v03 — argument map

*tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā.* You my sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; otherwise, wise. Silence over wisdom: *mūka* (dumb) beats *budha* (clever). The anti-eloquence verse.

chunks.sanskrit: aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana aho svādo virūpakṣety eva nṛtyeyam āraṭan

chunks.l2: Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting.
chunks.l3:
Ah, nectar-hoard, Master! Ah, sweet Three-eyed!
Ah, tasty Crooked-eyed! — so may I dance, yelling.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v04 — argument map

*aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana.* Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting. Praise by exclamation; three *aho*s as liturgy.

chunks.l2: Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness.
chunks.l3:
Eyes half-shut with Thy foot-lotus touch —
may I gape wide, reeling with Thy love-wine's drunkenness.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v05 — argument map

*tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ.* Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness. Touch narrows sight, widens being.

chunks.l2: May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle.
chunks.l3:
Mind-mountain on earth, may I dwell anywhere, All —
where that practice runs unbroken, deep-sapped, made of Thy babble.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v06 — argument map

*cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā.* May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle. Dwelling defined by practice, not place.

chunks.l3:
Where Thou standest with the Lady, many-shaped, from palace to gate-tower —
in that town may I dwell.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v07 — argument map

*yatra devīsametas tvam.* Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell. The divine household as address; *bahurūpa* domesticated.

chunks.l3:
May Thy sun-rays sport, Lord, till this heart-lotus of mine opens —
for Thy worship.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v08 — argument map

*samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ.* May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship. Blooming as the rays' festival, not the devotee's work.

chunks.l3:
Clear, Lord —
that my mind, ever fallen at Thy feet, tasting this and that, melt as wax, run.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v09 — argument map

*prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā.* Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — melts like wax, flows like... Wax-mind: tasting melts; melting is the prayer.

chunks.l2: Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord.
chunks.l3:
From joy though it burst from the pot, or from sorrow —
from outward feeling, inward feeling — show plain to me, Master.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v10 — argument map

*praharṣād vātha śokād vā.* Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord. Any trigger suffices; appear regardless of cause.

chunks.l3:
Without too, within too —
may that ever-oozing be mine: Thy foot-lotus-touch nectar, cool past cool.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v11 — argument map

*bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me.* Outside too, inside too — may that ever-streaming, Your coolest foot-lotus-touch-nectar, be mine always. Streaming touch, both directions.

chunks.l2: Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always.
chunks.l3:
Dived deep in Thy touch-nectar lake —
O what a joy past joys, leaping all enjoyment — be mine, ever.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v12 — argument map

*tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam.* Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always. Pleasure (*bhoga*) that surpasses (*laṅghī*) all pleasure.

chunks.l3:
Take the laid offering — passions and the rest, Lord, by me; take, nectarize, and feast —
with lover-folk, together.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v13 — argument map

*niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā.* Take what I offer — passion and the rest, Lord; make it nectar and eat it with devotees. The passions cooked into nectar and shared: offering as cuisine.

chunks.l3:
Ever sated on whole-world food, easy-seated —
Master, take among slaves one grace-glance-instant.

## s05-v14 — argument map

*aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam.* Ever-full on whole-world-food, happily seated — Master, cast Your grace-glance-moment on servants. The world-eater asked for one glance at servants.

chunks.l3:
Half-eyed, chewing inner love-wonder —
'bow to me, to Śiva' — worshiping, may I be, even straws.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v15 — argument map

*antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ.* Eyes half-closed, chewing inner devotion-wonder — "bow to me, to Śiva" — may I worship even straw. Self as Śiva addressed; straw as liturgy-worthy.

## s05-v16 — argument map

*api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ.* Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments. Gaining without leaving: enjoyment as non-parting's seal.

Thine — secondless — fullness is but fit.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v17 — argument map

*ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate.* Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting. Desire's end as fitness-proof.

chunks.l3:
Where 'tis laughed, 'tis danced —
where hates-and-loves are eaten, love-nectar drunk — may I win that foot-place.

## s05-v18 — argument map

*hasyate nṛtyate yatra.* Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place. The festival as destination.

chunks.l3:

## s05-v19 — argument map

*tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā.* May that unprecedented-joy-perfume of thought-flowers about You firm up in my mind — till bad-smell of bad-habit perishes. Fragrance vs stink: thought's smell decides.

chunks.l3:
Where, pray, love among passions —
and where loving 'mid Hara's foot-lotuses? So teach my clash-fond heart its good, Deathless.

## s05-v20 — argument map

*kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam.* Where is love among passions, and where is loving at Hari's lotus-feet — thus teach my contradiction-loving heart what is good, O Deathless. Comparison as instruction; the heart addressed as contradiction-lover.

chunks.l3:
Roaming yoga-states even, turned from sense-things even —
Thy-thought-wine's frenzy liquifying my heart — only that may I be.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v21 — argument map

*vicaran yogadaśāsv api.* Though wandering even through yogic states, though turned away from objects — may I be only heart-melted by Your-thought-liquor-madness. States passed through, not dwelt in; melting only by Him.

*vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu.* In speech, mind-thoughts, body-gestures made by senses — everywhere, always, may bhakti-rasa go before me as leader. Devotion as vanguard (*puraḥsara*) of every faculty.

## s08-v01 (1)

chunks.argmap:
## s08-v01 — argument map

Grace-drop (prasādalava) stationed in the Lord (īśvarasthito); devotion (bhakti) come as if to meet me (iva mām upeyuṣī). The pair (tau) joined (parasparasamanvitau) — when will they take root (rūḍhim eṣyataḥ) in such a body (tādṛśe vapuṣi)? The verse poses the meeting as a question, not an assertion: the devotee does not claim the upsurge has happened.

### Open
- Whether 'prasādalava' means 'drop of grace' or 'grace's drop' (genitive) is unresolved.
- Whether 'tādṛśe vapuṣi' refers to the devotee's body or the Lord's body is unresolved.

## s08-v02 (2)

chunks.argmap:
## s08-v02 — argument map

Born of chewing His lordship (tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā): may some inner joy-juice (paritoṣaraso) rise ('ntaḥ udetu). Here always be supreme for me (sarvakālam iha me param astu) — knowledge-yoga's glories far off (jñānayogamahimādi vidūre). The verse converts chewing (carvaṇa) into a method: rumination produces joy-juice, displacing metaphysics.

### Open
- Whether 'ko 'pi' (some) refers to joy-juice or to a person is unresolved.
- Whether 'param' (supreme) modifies 'astu' or 'me' is unresolved.

chunks.argmap:
## s14-v01 — argument map

Before my own master, treasure of victory-fortune (jayalakṣmīnidhānasya nijasya svāminaḥ puraḥ) — may I taste for a moment the nectar of victory-proclamation (jayodghoṣaṇapīyūṣarasam āsvādaye kṣaṇam). The verse opens with tasting, not describing: the devotee asks to taste the victory-proclamation.

Thy lovers alone, in truth.
chunks.argmap:
## s15-v01 — argument map

Not the book-washed (grantha), not the yogin, not the scholar, not the detached, not the master, not the liberation-seeker — but the drunk. The devotee is defined against every spiritual résumé: neither seeking exit nor wielding method, but growing. Devotion is not a means among means; it is the thing yogins/scholars/ascetics circle without entering.

### Open
- Whether 'grantha' means 'book-washed' or 'book-learned' is unresolved.
- Whether 'matta' means 'drunk' or 'intoxicated' is unresolved.

- Swamiji (Academy, ch17): worship no longer confined to ritual acts — the whole universe felt as the substance of worship itself; this verse is that doctrine in miniature.
